# SRVCABLE — illustrative offline reference (NOT generated by the LLM agent)

## Snapshot
Sarvottam Cables Ltd manufactures power cables, wires and conductors. Its official Q1 FY27 release reports revenue of ₹1,248 crore (+18% YoY), EBITDA of ₹140 crore (+2.6%), and PAT of ₹82 crore (+5.9%); EBITDA margin fell from 12.9% to 11.2%. [S3] The order book was ₹3,900 crore, and a new Bharuch plant is expected to add about 30% capacity. [S3]

## Bull case
- The reported order book grew from ₹3,150 crore to ₹3,900 crore year over year. [S3]
- Exports rose to 21% of revenue from 16%; management cites demand from power transmission and data-centre projects. [S3]
- Management maintains FY27 revenue growth guidance of 15–17%; the Bharuch plant is expected to begin commercial production in Q3 FY27. These are forward-looking company statements, not guarantees. [S2, S3]
- Promoter shareholding was 58.2% in June 2026, and pledged shares were reported at 4.1% of promoter holding, down from 11.5% in June 2025. [S8]

## Bear case
- Margins compressed by 170 basis points as copper costs rose; management says price-variation clauses cover about two-thirds of contracts but reset with a one-to-two-quarter lag. [S2, S3]
- Receivable days increased from 78 to 96, driven by two large state utility customers with slower payments. Management reported no defaults, but collection timing remains a risk. [S3]
- A September 2026 exchange disclosure reports a ₹46.3 crore GST demand related to FY2020–21 and FY2021–22 input tax credit. The company intends to appeal and says it does not expect a material impact; the outcome is unresolved in the supplied pack. [S7]

## Open questions
- The official release reports Q1 revenue of ₹1,248 crore and +18% YoY, while a news article reports ₹1,428 crore and +35%. The supplied sources do not explain this material discrepancy; the official release is used above, but the conflict needs checking. [S1, S3]
- The 2024 article says promoter pledging reached 35%, whereas the June 2026 exchange summary reports pledged shares at 4.1% of promoter holding. The older article should not be treated as current; the basis and chronology would need verification. [S4, S8]
- The local news item concerns “Sarvottam Cable Network,” a cable TV/broadband operator in Nagpur, not clearly the listed power-cable manufacturer. No evidence in the pack establishes that they are the same entity, so the ₹8 lakh penalty is not attributed to SRVCABLE. [S6]
- The stock-tip blog's ₹1,450 target and “60% upside” are promotional, and the blog discloses it is not SEBI registered; the pack provides no reliable analyst consensus supporting the claim. [S5]
